﻿from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from Projects.Applications.PrismataLabs.python.schema_validator import (
    classify_object,
    validate_collection,
    validate_menu_item,
    validate_ui_framework,
)


def _labs2_examples() -> Path:
    return (
        ROOT
        / "Projects"
        / "Applications"
        / "PrismataLabs"
        / "examples"
        / "objects"
    )


def _load_yaml(path: Path):
    import yaml

    return yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def test_classify_ui_framework_and_collections():
    examples = _labs2_examples()
    framework = _load_yaml(examples / "ui_frameworks" / "single-pane.ui-framework.yaml")
    borders = _load_yaml(examples / "shared" / "borders.yaml")

    assert classify_object(framework) == "ui-framework"
    assert classify_object(borders) == "border-pattern-collection"


def test_validate_ui_framework_example_passes():
    examples = _labs2_examples()
    framework = _load_yaml(examples / "ui_frameworks" / "single-pane.ui-framework.yaml")

    valid, errors = validate_ui_framework(framework)

    assert valid is True
    assert errors == []


def test_validate_border_collection_example_passes():
    examples = _labs2_examples()
    borders = _load_yaml(examples / "shared" / "borders.yaml")

    valid, errors = validate_collection(borders, "border-pattern")

    assert valid is True
    assert errors == []


def test_validate_menu_item_rejects_unknown_capability():
    item = {
        "id": "example-item",
        "udi": "prismata.examples.menu-item.example-item",
        "kind": "menu-item",
        "label": "Example Item",
        "capability": "prismata.examples.capability.not-declared",
        "visibility_mode": "static",
        "enable_mode": "enabled",
    }

    valid, errors = validate_menu_item(
        item,
        capability_index={"prismata.examples.capability.print-hello"},
    )

    assert valid is False
    assert any("Capability not declared" in err for err in errors)
